definitions.full: H4407. Millo מִלּוֺא proper name, of a location (Thes ' fill ' of earth, earthwork, but see GFM Judg 9:6 ); **Schw ZMG lii (1898), 137 compare Assyrian mulu = earthwork, mound, terrace , Dl 411 M-A 544 . — 1 מִלּוֺא בֵּית Judg 9:6 (|| שְׁכֶם בַּעֲלֵי ) so 9:20 ; 9:20 ; near Shechem, site unknown; ᵐ5 οἶκος Βηθμααλων . 2 citadel in Jerusalem הַמִּלּוֺא 2Sam 5:9 ; 1Kin 9:15 , 24 ; 11:27 ; 1Chr 11:8 ; 2Chr 32:5 . ᵐ5 usually ἡ ἄκρα (A 1Kin 9:15 , 24 also Μελω ). 3 מִלֹּא בֵּית 2Kin 12:21 (+ סִלָּא הַיֹּרֵד ) dubious; = 2 ? ᵐ5 οἴκῳ Μααλω .
